notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
The token Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
